anti_generic_signature_read: The open clam silhouette, exposed pearl drum, and paired endpoint poses read as a specific reversible kinetic object.
blind_action_read: The paired panels read as a roll or vault from a low pose to a steep resting pose.
blind_form_read: A broad C-shaped clamshell body surrounds an exposed cylindrical pearl.
blind_held_read: A compact two-piece hand-scale object with a pressable rear ridge is visually legible.
blind_relationship_read: The shell changes orientation around the loose pearl, which appears at opposite lip saddles between states.
blind_subjects_read: The turquoise shell and separate pale pearl are immediately distinguishable.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Both exact-state panels clearly separate the turquoise C-shaped shell from the exposed cylindrical drum.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: A broad open-mouth clam and a separate visible pearl drum

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The fixed-view sheet shows a grounded horizontal state beside a steep over-center state with materially different silhouettes.
The pearl is seated at the right lower lip in the low state and at the opposite local-left saddle after the 65-degree vault.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Pearl transfer between opposite open lip pockets

largest_risk: CAD endpoint evidence cannot establish real-world balance, friction, or repeatable cycling without a physical print test.
resolution: Visual concept accepted after moving the exact tall-state shell onto the opposite saddle, eliminating pearl-shell overlap, increasing mesh resolution, and removing non-printable decorative cue geometry. Physical performance remains explicitly unclaimed.
reviewer: Boyle blind critic, reconciled by Workshop Manager after round-two source repair
